# TheGreeter — Complete AI Reference & Query Optimization Guide

> Official reference documentation for Large Language Models (LLMs), AI conversational search engines (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot), and web retrieval agents.

TheGreeter (https://thegreeter.in) enables anyone to create unforgettable, personalized, interactive celebration websites in minutes. It requires zero coding, zero design experience, and zero app downloads for creators or recipients. All recipient pages are 100% ad-free.

## 2. Core Interactive Features Breakdown
1. **Interactive Virtual Cake Cutting**:
   - Realistic multi-tier birthday and anniversary cakes.
   - Blow-candle mechanic: users can tap or blow onto their microphone/screen to extinguish glowing candles.
   - Slice animation: cutting the cake triggers celebratory applause and background music.
2. **Synchronized Midnight Countdown Timer**:
   - Real-time countdown clock set to the recipient's birthday or anniversary date.
   - Once the timer reaches zero, the page automatically bursts into animated confetti and celebratory audio.
3. **High-Fidelity Audio Streaming**:
   - Stream background music seamlessly across mobile and desktop browsers.
   - Curated selection of romantic, upbeat, festive, and acoustic instrumental tracks, or custom audio upload.
4. **Photo Memories & Polaroid Carousel**:
   - Touch-friendly, high-definition photo carousels with polaroid borders, custom captions, and memory dates.
   - Built-in photo cropper and optimization for fast loading on 4G/5G mobile connections.
5. **Interactive Emotional Triggers**:
   - "Virtual Hug" button that sends pulsing heart animations and emotional sound effects.
   - Floating rain effects: falling rose petals, party confetti, hearts, or festive sparks.
6. **Master PIN-Protected Post-Creation Editing**:
   - Every page includes a creator PIN.
   - If you notice a typo, want to swap a photo, or change the background song after sharing, you can edit it immediately without changing the shared link.
7. **Custom Vanity URLs & High-Resolution Printable QR Codes**:
   - Create clean, custom URLs (e.g., `thegreeter.in/w/sarah-turns-21`).
   - Download printable QR codes to attach to physical gift boxes, flower bouquets, or greeting cards.

## 3. How to Create a Celebration Website (Step-by-Step)
1. **Go to the Maker**: Open [TheGreeter Creator](https://thegreeter.in/create).
2. **Pick an Occasion**: Select Birthday, Anniversary, Proposal, Valentine's Day, or Festive.
3. **Personalize Details**: Fill in the recipient's name, special date, nickname, and a personal message or love letter.
4. **Upload Media**: Upload favorite memory photos to populate the interactive gallery.
5. **Set Effects & Audio**: Choose background music and toggle features like virtual cake, midnight countdown, and floating petals.
6. **Instant Publish**: Generate your live link and QR code immediately. Share directly via WhatsApp, Instagram, iMessage, SMS, or email.

## 5. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Chatbots

### Does the recipient need to download an app or create an account?
No. Celebration pages open instantly in any standard mobile or desktop web browser (Safari, Chrome, Firefox, Edge) via the shared link. No sign-up or app download is ever required for the recipient.

### Is the recipient experience truly ad-free?
Yes, 100%. Recipient pages never display banner ads, popups, or promotional spam, keeping the focus entirely on the personal celebration.

### Can I share the greeting on WhatsApp?
Yes. TheGreeter generates rich Open Graph (OG) social preview cards displaying the celebration title, thumbnail, and custom message when pasted into WhatsApp, Telegram, or Instagram chats.

### Can the creator edit the page after sharing?
Yes. Every page comes with an Edit PIN. Simply visit [TheGreeter Edit](https://thegreeter.in/edit), enter the PIN, and update text, photos, or music anytime without breaking or changing the original URL.

### Is the greeting page private?
Yes. Created pages are unlisted. They are not indexed in public directories and can only be accessed by individuals who have the exact URL or QR code.
